notes: Fixed the half-second freeze every time you switch worlds or servers (Minecraft 1.8.9 to 1.16).
Opening Options or Video Settings no longer reloads your chunks when Performance mode is on.
Click the number next to any slider to type an exact value.
New settings: Block outline can fill the block, Time changer has a custom hour, and Toggle sneak can keep sneaking after menus.
Esc now removes a keybind in the Auoris settings, and removing the emote wheel key in Controls sticks.
The AI: /agents 8 sets how many helper agents it can run for one prompt (/agents auto resets it), it can read public web pages, and /remember adds a note it keeps for that folder.
Fixed the game freezing for several seconds each time you switched worlds or servers with Performance mode on (joining a server could even time out on Logging in).
Ask before disconnecting is now off by default (turn it on in Settings if you want it).

Fixes two problems in 1.9.1: the new main menu backgrounds were missing (the menu was plain dark and the picker could not show them), and Hide loading screen showed the dirt loading screen again when you switch worlds or servers.
Both work again.
New menu backgrounds: pick from 14 backgrounds with the button at the top right of the main menu (point at one to preview it), or add your own pictures.
New account switcher: every account shows its face, hovering one shows it in 3D with its cape, and you can drag accounts into any order, in game or in the app.
Streamer mode (Settings > Streamer mode) hides server addresses, your name, private messages and your skin, each with its own switch, and replaces the Stream-proof HUD.
Disconnect asks first on servers, so a misclick doesn't drop you out of a game.
Minecraft starts faster and stays hidden until its menu is ready, with no loading screens.
Hide loading screen also skips the dirt screen between worlds.
New RAM optimizer (Settings, off by default) frees memory other programs aren't using when your PC runs low.
Replay clips save as MP4 and get Watch and Open folder buttons.
Hurtcam is now a slider from no shake to vanilla.
The emote wheel key can no longer get stuck on none.
Dragging the skin preview in the app turns the skin.
Privacy Policy and Acceptable Use Policy updated.

Big FPS boost: chat and the scoreboard are drawn from a cached picture instead of letter by letter every frame, the game no longer checks for graphics errors twice every frame, and Performance mode turns off OptiFine's Smooth FPS.
Golden apples always register now: your client waits for the server to finish the eat (Gapple sync), and Armor switch no longer cancels eating.
New Discord rich presence: your Discord profile shows Playing Auoris Client with the server you're on and its icon (Settings > Discord).
Graphics and brightness settings you change no longer switch back by themselves.
The emote wheel key and other Auoris keybinds no longer reset.
Auto text waits half a second after you close chat, so a letter typed right after doesn't fire it.
Players with arrows in them no longer vanish for a moment.
The in-game translator and /ai work again for chat with symbols like ».
Scrolling while zoomed no longer delays your clicks.
Fixed the water crash ('Tesselating block in world') still happening right after joining a server next to a waterfall.
Fixed a crash on chunks with a lot of water ('Tesselating block in world').
Ground pets now stand on the blocks under them instead of hanging at the wrong height after you fly, climb or swim.
Fixed freezes on servers with NPCs (like Pika Network): broken scoreboard updates from the server no longer stall the game.
When the game does freeze for a moment, one line about it now goes into the game's log, to help track down stutters.
Updated Terms and Privacy Policy.
Fixed low FPS: FPS boost no longer limits your frame rate when Windows thinks the game isn't focused (second monitor, a second game window, overlays).
Fixed a small stutter every couple of seconds from the audio device check.
Fixed a coloured tint that could show up when a far-away mob was hit.
The Team window shows an example prompt.
Updated Privacy Policy.
Fixed Minecraft crashing at startup on some sound devices (newer OpenAL).
Your game now stays online for friends and other players even if you close the Auoris app.
Only one Auoris runs at a time; opening it again brings the same window back.
Auoris pauses its animations when it isn't focused, so it takes less from your FPS.
Account switching works with two game windows open.
Chat hotkeys can be edited.
Fixed garbled arrows and dashes in the mod.
Team mode knows your name and instructions and compares models through your linked accounts.
Smooth font in the Auoris menus (Settings > Menu look).
Cleaner mod menu: brighter descriptions, lined-up counts, smooth scrolling edges, no key hint.
Emotes and Cosmetics now live on their own hub tiles.
Screenshot buttons sit on the screenshot line.
Potion effects are hidden in the inventory by default.
Closing Auoris while Minecraft runs keeps it in the tray, and opening it again brings the same window back.
A clear message when the AI declines a request.
Screenshot buttons in chat (Copy, Open in Explorer, Delete).
New Chunk borders module.
Fly boost in Toggle sprint (creative).
1.7 Visuals: armour flashes red when hit.
Capes and wings move as you walk.
Redesigned pets.
Translated chat now sends only plain keyboard characters.
Search chats moved above Explore, and the empty member list no longer takes space in DMs.
Cosmetics: redesigned pets and hats, a new wings slot, reworked emotes with custom sounds.
Minecraft: a faster resource pack menu, the potion HUD in inventory order, and the Auoris mod now updates together with the app.
Security: Minecraft is protected against Log4Shell chat messages and runs on an up-to-date Java 8.
Minecraft ownership is checked without your sign-in token leaving the PC.
System health scan fixes, and a much smaller installer.

Minecraft client: new Settings tab (nametags, HUD, controls, menu look, backup and reset), see your own nametag in F5, update notes now wrap and scroll instead of being cut off, Inventory mod shows in the menu again, and many new module options.

App: a cleaner message bar (one upload button for files and images, Call is now at the top right, the prompt library moved to Settings > Prompts), Stop during compaction keeps your chat, connector programs shut down fully, queued /extra and /team wait for the current reply, plus more reliability fixes.
Security updates for bundled libraries.
